title: Why Does a Basketball Bounce? #Shorts
description:
Why does a basketball bounce? When it hits the floor the bottom flattens, the air inside gets squeezed, and that squeezed air shoves back like a spring. A flat ball loses that push to bending rubber, heat and sound, and a ball left out in the cold bounces lower because the cold air inside pushes weaker.

Explained in 60 #14
